title: The Undone Years. Fire
identity: Australian Music Centre catalog links David Keeffe's The Undone Years to a concerto for tenor saxophone with strings, piano and timpani. Bourbaki Ensemble's 2011 program gives the work's four movements as I The Undone Years, II The Old Lie, III Spring Winds and IV Legs as Quick as Lilac-shoots, performed by Jason Xanthoudakis. The catalog title 'The Undone Years. Fire' does not match that program's movement titles, so the relationship of 'Fire' remains unresolved.
